about: The corpus for the preregistered study in evidence/impact/protocol.md. Selection and provenance only. No page here has been run. Every commit, licence and file path in this file was read from the GitHub API on the date below, not recalled.
howToReadThis: Each entry names the numbered criterion that admitted or excluded it. Section 6 criteria are the inclusion criteria and all five must hold. Section 7 bullets are the exclusion criteria and any one of them is enough. An entry with included false is not a judgement about the code; it is a statement that one criterion in the protocol does not hold for it.

population.note: GitHub code search returns at most 1000 results per query, so these five queries together are a bounded view of the field rather than the whole of it. The reported total_count for each query is also unstable between calls and is not recorded here for that reason.
population.screeningRule: Every one of the 1076 returned repositories had its licence, default branch, homepage and Pages flag read from its repository record, which is the licence census below. Repositories were then ordered for file by file inspection by how likely the returned path was to be a page rather than a library: an .html file first, then a .js or .mjs file outside node_modules, dist, build and minified bundles. For each of those the blob was fetched at the pinned commit and read for the receiver of the registerTool call, for bare package imports, and for script tags pointing off origin. File by file inspection stopped once the included set had passed the protocol's target of ten, which is why 52 repositories carry an entry and the remaining 1024 are counted in the population only. Nothing was rejected during that pass for anything other than a numbered criterion.

licenceCensus.note: Read from .license.spdx_id on the repository record of every repository the five queries returned. NULL means GitHub found no licence file at all. NOASSERTION means it found one it could not identify, which is why the two entries in this file carrying NOASSERTION had their LICENSE blob read directly instead. One repository record could not be fetched, so the rows below total 1075 rather than 1076. Read against section 6 criterion 3, the 371 NULL and the 61 NOASSERTION repositories are the largest single obstacle in the field: four in ten of the repositories that write WebMCP tool registrations carry no licence that permits running them for inspection.

counts.note: These count the one criterion recorded as decisive for each excluded entry, so they sum to 39. Several entries fail more than one criterion and their notes field names the others.

targetN.statement: Thirteen repositories meet all five inclusion criteria and carry a page that can be served from the pinned commit by a plain static file server with no install step. The protocol's census framing in section 8 applies only when fewer than ten are eligible, so it does not apply. This set is a screened subset of a 1076 repository population, selected by the stated screening rule, and it is not a random sample.
